extracted_information: Tidio offers a range of pricing plans including Free, Starter, Growth, Plus, and Premium, alongside standalone options for Lyro AI Agent and Flows. Pricing is primarily based on 'Billable conversations', 'Lyro AI conversations', and 'Visitors reached with Flows'. A 7-day free trial provides access to all features.

billable_conversations_per_month.definition: A 'Billable conversation' is any live chat, ticket, email, or social media conversation that includes a message from a human agent. Unanswered messages or responses from Flows and Lyro AI Agent are not counted. Multiple messages within a single thread count as one billable conversation.

features.description: For solo entrepreneurs starting with live chat and basic automation.
Includes all Free features, suitable for basic automation.
Includes all Starter features, designed to optimize support operations and drive customer satisfaction.
Includes all Growth features, offering better limits, additional integrations, advanced features, and premium support.
Includes all Plus features, providing managed services, implementation, and continuous support of the AI Agent.
included_features: Lyro AI as a managed service

lyro_ai_agent.description: AI-powered support chatbot designed to solve up to 67% of customer problems by automatically answering common questions and performing recurring tasks. It learns from support content (FAQ upload, FAQ scraper, Website scraper) to generate personalized, human-like responses.
key_features: Understands intent and generates responses based on provided information
Lyro product recommendation (with paid Lyro quota)
Can be integrated with other customer service tools

flows.description: No-code conversion paths that trigger at crucial moments to increase conversions by 26%. Used as a marketing automation tool, they answer simple, pre-defined questions and proactively engage users.
flows.distinction_from_lyro_ai: Flows rely on pre-designed conversational paths and manual configuration, while Lyro AI Agent uses AI/NLP for understanding complex questions without being restricted to pre-defined answers.

temporal_info.free_trial: 7-day free trial offering full access to all Tidio features and plans; no credit card required.
temporal_info.subscription_changes: Downgrade or upgrade subscriptions anytime; changes take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
temporal_info.conversation_limit_refresh_cycle: Monthly refresh (30 days from payment for paid plans, 30 days from account creation or end of last paid subscription for Free plan).
